text:
Evelyn - CS: Quick ask — Oriana (APAC) wants a compact enablement series late-afternoon their time (UTC+8). Goal: obs, regression checks, and handoff for Dedicated migration. Renewal looks lukewarm, NPS dip last quarter.
Marco - CSM: They prefer 90-min "twilight" sessions over 4 evenings so their engineers can join after client ops. Can we do labs + a short exec pulse on final night?
Tess - Enablement: I can run Days 1 and 4. Proposed structure: 90m = 30m teach + 45m hands-on lab + 15m actions+survey. Who can cover Days 2/3?
Ibrahim - SE: I'll take Day 2 (observability/tracing deep-dive) and provide a tiny tracing agent example. Day 3 Ill be on-site with another customer, but can host office hours after Day 2.
Evelyn - CS: Must capture renewal signals each night: adoption actions, blockers, and exec asks. Also want a short runbook for embedding errors included in Day 2 lab if health check shows regressions.
Tess - Enablement: Draft agenda (compressed):
Day 1: platform intro & quick deploy (30m) / lab: run hello-infer in their env (45m) / actions + micro-survey (15m)
Day 2: observability & traces (30m) / lab: attach tracing + interpret flame charts (45m) / actions + survey (15m)
Day 3: regression testing & evals (30m) / lab: run a small eval harness + CI integration (45m) / actions + survey (15m)
Day 4: dedicated migration patterns + rollout checklist (30m) / lab: dry-run migration steps (45m) / exec pulse + renewal checkpoint (15m)
Marco - CSM: Looks good. Can we add a tiny CI snippet for Day 3 that runs a quantized model smoke test? That would help surface perf regressions early.
Ibrahim - SE: Will add a bash snippet and a GitHub Actions example. Example: 
```bash
# smoke test for quantized model
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.latency_ms'
```
Tess - Enablement: Feedback capture plan: micro-survey (3 qs) after each session + 2 poll questions in-session (confidence, blockers). Im also planning a single consolidated post-week feedback doc for CS.
Evelyn - CS: Scheduler: customer only available Mon-Thu evenings (UTC+8) in two-week window starting 1790500000. Need final agenda EOD Fri (1788881450). Can presenters ack and confirm any pre-flight health-checks?
Ibrahim - SE: ack. I'll prepare a health-check script to run 48h before Day 1 and will flag embedding error-rate and token latency.
Tess - Enablement: ack. I'll prepare pre-read + lab repo link.
Calendar Bot: Tentative slots created: Mon-Thu 18:30-20:00 (UTC+8) for Oriana enablement week (pending finalization).
Marco - CSM: Also request that a renewal lead (sales ops) join the Day 4 exec pulse for quick review. I'll loop them in once agenda final.
Evelyn - CS: Great. I'll log the plan in the renewal tracker and add a risk note about the recent NPS drop. Please drop all lab links and the smoke-test gist in the shared folder. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
